hotspots.title: TWIN NACELLES
hotspots.summary: Twin plasma nacelles. Flight assist holds your speed and damps the drift when you let go of the stick.

hotspots.title: CANNONS
hotspots.summary: Paired cheek cannons along the nose. A spread pickup adds a second barrel on each side.

hotspots.title: MISSILE RACKS
hotspots.summary: Underwing racks. They stay dark until a missile pickup arms them, then the tubes and seeker tips show on the hull.

hotspots.title: SHIELD EMITTERS
hotspots.summary: Wing-root dishes project the forward barrier. A shield pickup restores the barrier and lights the dishes.

hotspots.title: REACTOR
hotspots.summary: Dorsal core for the guns, the barrier, and the tractor. A hull-repair pickup seats the core and patches 40 hull.

hotspots.title: COCKPIT
hotspots.summary: Single-seat canopy. In the lane, COCKPIT puts you behind the glass with the stick and the instrument glow.
